parsed.title: SECURITY SYSTEM CONTROL
parsed.body:
Discard 1 [ICON: white shield-shaped glyph with central vertical split] from any Room in your Section to choose
a Corridor adjacent to that Room. Roll a Burst die and
deal Hits equal to the result in the chosen Corridor.
[burstDieAdditionalEffects]: Place a [malfunction] on this Item.
confidentlyVisible: All typography is upright in the file.
The artwork depicts a mounted gun or security turret.
The title is printed in large white uppercase text.
HEAVY is printed in yellow beneath the title.
A red prohibition symbol over a white curled exoskeleton appears at upper right.
A purple square with four white corner marks begins the final effect line.
A grey cog-shaped malfunction icon appears before “on this Item.”
uncertainties: The white shield-shaped line-leading resource glyph after “Discard 1” is not confidently matched to the supplied canonical glossary, so it is described literally.
The exact formal subtype beyond the visibly printed HEAVY trait is not stated on the card.
